description: This file contains the implementation of the BordersRenderer class, responsible for rendering border styles (including color, width, style, and position) in a PDF document using PdfSharp, as part of the MigraDoc PDF document creation library.

classes.name: BordersRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering border styles on a PDF graphics context, including methods for rendering borders vertically, horizontally, diagonally, and with rounded corners.

methods.name: GetBorder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific border of a given BorderType.

methods.name: GetColor
methods.description: Gets the color for a specified border type, considering border-specific color and default border color.

methods.name: GetStyle
methods.description: Determines the style of a specified border type, defaulting to single if not specified.

methods.name: GetWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a specified border type, considering border visibility and override settings.

methods.name: RenderVertically
methods.description: Renders a vertical border line for a specified border type.

methods.name: RenderHorizontally
methods.description: Renders a horizontal border line for a specified border type.

methods.name: RenderDiagonally
methods.description: Renders a diagonal border line for a specified border type.

methods.name: RenderRounded
methods.description: Renders a rounded corner for a border with specified corner type, position, and size.

methods.name: GetPen
methods.description: Creates and configures an XPen object based on border width, color, and style.

methods.name: IsRendered
methods.description: Checks if a particular border type is rendered (visible and width > 0).
